description: Performance SLO for the hook hot path (R6-02). Graded by `node scripts/perf-baseline.js --slo`; regression thresholds, waiver, and investigation flow live in spec/OPERATOR.md §O9. It grades three independent dimensions: per-hook timeout headroom, conservative aggregate process cost, and concurrent event wall latency. scope_events excludes SessionStart because it fires once per session and legitimately pays the arbitration inspector.

aggregate_process.note: Sum of per-hook ON p95 values, which is conservative aggregate process cost rather than user wall latency. Two registered surfaces imply two physical copies; the 2.5 ratio allows that expected doubling plus bounded arbitration/yield cost without using a machine-dependent absolute millisecond cap.

concurrent_wall.note: p95 elapsed time from launching all matching event hooks concurrently until the last exits. This mirrors Codex scheduling but excludes Codex IPC, so it remains a lower-bound harness metric. It is graded separately from aggregate process cost.

stability.note: Across rounds, per-event p95 totals may differ by at most this fraction (max/min - 1); beyond it the verdict is INCONCLUSIVE (exit 3), never a single-noisy-run FAIL.
